entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NativeAOT: missing acquire ordering in SyncTable readers #135173
  • NativeAOT: MethodInfo.Invoke on a ref-returning method can return a wrong object (ref return escapes invoke helper's argument storage) #135170
  • Try to resolve exact targets for constrained static interface calls #135168
  • JIT: Atomic Address Containment #135166

  • [ci-scan-feedback] Dedup crashing-compile build breaks on compiled-asset path #135164

  • Add analyzer to detect runtime `InvalidOperationException` from LINQ operations that require comparable keys #135161
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: AppHost.Bundle.Tests.BundledAppWithSubDirs reuses a stale extraction on macOS Helix #135155
  • cDAC: a cyclic Frame chain makes IStackWalk.CreateStackWalk loop forever #135154
  • Debugger Hot Reload with a profiler loaded: `CanSetEnCBits` refuses it, `DOTNET_MODIFIABLE_ASSEMBLIES=debug` allows it. Is that the supported route? #135152
  • Linux/macOS: the debugging services reap a launched debuggee with `waitpid` and drop its exit status, so debuggers report "exited with code 0" for a crash (re-raising #43731) #135151
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #135150
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Interop/COM/NativeClients/Dispatch/Dispatch.cmd exits 0xC0000409 #135149

    Future

    11.0.0
